title: Forward sweep over a zone
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes, let $j \in \mathbb{Z}$, and let $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Processing the concatenation of the $n$ blocks at coordinates $j$ through $j+n-1$, with their left-neighbour flags initially false, by the forward sweep started from the control table at $j$ yields the control table at $j+n$ and those same blocks with their left-neighbour head flags recorded.
hypotheses_covered: configuration c of a k-work-tape machine
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine, $j \in \mathbb{Z}$, and
$n \in \mathbb{N}$. The forward sweep over the concatenation of the $n$ unread blocks at
coordinates $j, \dots, j+n-1$, started from the control table at $j$, ends in the
control table at $j+n$ and produces the corresponding blocks with left-neighbour head
flags recorded.
